thread:
Rae (Product Design): Quick sync on the vectors table — users report the compact rows feel too "thin" and the Export action is ambiguous (selected vs visible). Figma: https://redwood.ai/s/vec-compact2 :thinking:
Jun (Frontend): I noticed the jump when toggling rows because the export dropdown inherits width from the selection count. Proposal: reserve a fixed export column width and render a 24px sparkline in compact mode so people still get a visual cue without full preview. CSS anchor the dropdown to avoid layout shift.
Lina (A11y): Agree on sparklines, but they must not rely on color alone. Each sparkline should have a concise aria-label like "sparkline: low to high relevance" and include a <title> in the SVG. Export options need clear aria-labels: "Export selected vectors", "Export visible vectors", "Export all vectors". Also ensure keyboard shortcut opens the export menu and focus is trapped inside it.
Omar (PM): From the user interviews: folks expected Export to default to selected items. Let's make the dropdown default to "Export selected" and add helper text below the button: "Exports only selected rows unless you choose another option." Persist compact/comfortable as a user preference.
Mika (Design Intern): Mocked two small variations: one with muted chip colors + border and one with bolder chips but reduced saturation. Uploaded: https://redwood.ai/s/mock-spark.png :art:
Jun (Frontend): I'll prototype the sparkline SVG and the anchored dropdown in storybook (branch: feature/vec-spark-export). I'll also add aria-controls/aria-expanded on row toggles and ensure focus moves into expanded content.
render-bot: Preview storybook: https://staging.redwood.ai/builds/1972345555-storybook (includes compact/comfortable toggle, sparklines, and export dropdown mock).
Rae (Product Design): Great — checklist before PR: fixed export column, 24px sparklines with aria/title, export aria-labels and helper copy, keyboard shortcut, persist preference. We'll gate behind flag `vec-spark-experiment` and run a small pilot. Thanks!
